title: Second part (2 parts)
spec:

Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Rotate the sketch using the Euler angles 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and translate it using the vector 0.0, 0.0212, 0.0. import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Create the S-shaped object
s_shape = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0495)
    .threePointArc((0.182, 0.0), (0.364, 0.0495))
    .threePointArc((0.3528, 0.0912), (0.3276, 0.1296))
    .threePointArc((0.3024, 0.168), (0.2772, 0.1296))
    .threePointArc((0.252, 0.0912), (0.2408, 0.0495))
    .threePointArc((0.4228, 0.0), (0.6048, 0.0495))
    .threePointArc((0.5936, 0.0912), (0.5684, 0.1296))
    .threePointArc((0.5432, 0.168), (0.518, 0.1296))
    .threePointArc((0.5068, 0.0912), (0.4816, 0.0495))
    .threePointArc((0.2408, 0.1525), (0.0, 0.0495))
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0085)
    .translate((0.0726, 0.0763, 0.0))
)

# Part 2: Create the ring and join it to the S-shaped object
ring = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.1525, 0.1525)
    .circle(0.1525)
    .moveTo(0.1525, 0.1525)
    .circle(0.1103)
    .moveTo(0.6002, 0.1525)
    .circle(0.1525)
    .moveTo(0.6002, 0.1525)
    .circle(0.1103)
    .extrude(0.0085)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0085))
)

# Combine the S-shaped object and the ring
r = s_shape.union(ring)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
total_x = 0.75
total_y = 0.3051
t_ring = 0.0169   # ring thickness (Z)
t_web = 0.008     # connecting web thickness (thinner than rings)

R_out = total_y / 2.0        # outer radius of rings
R_in = 0.11                  # inner radius of rings

# Ring centers along X
cx1 = R_out
cx2 = total_x - R_out
cx_mid = (cx1 + cx2) / 2.0

# Two outer ring bodies
rings = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(cx1, 0.0).circle(R_out)
    .moveTo(cx2, 0.0).circle(R_out)
    .extrude(t_ring)
)

# Holes through the rings
holes = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(cx1, 0.0).circle(R_in)
    .moveTo(cx2, 0.0).circle(R_in)
    .extrude(t_ring)
)

rings = rings.cut(holes)

# Connecting web with concave edges between the rings
web = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(cx1, 0.10)
    .threePointArc((cx_mid, 0.055), (cx2, 0.10))
    .lineTo(cx2, -0.10)
    .threePointArc((cx_mid, -0.055), (cx1, -0.10))
    .close()
    .extrude(t_web)
)

# Keep the ring holes clear of the web material
web = web.cut(holes)

# Final part
r = rings.union(web)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Central connecting web (thinner than the rings)
web = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0.00295)
    .moveTo(0.204565, 0.259040)
    .threePointArc((0.0, 0.15255), (0.204565, 0.046060))
    .threePointArc((0.375, 0.0775), (0.499393, 0.035696))
    .threePointArc((0.75, 0.15255), (0.499393, 0.269404))
    .threePointArc((0.375, 0.2276), (0.204565, 0.259040))
    .close()
    .extrude(0.011)
)

# Left and right rings (full thickness)
ring1 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.13, 0.15255).circle(0.13).extrude(0.0169)
ring2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.59745, 0.15255).circle(0.15255).extrude(0.0169)

# Combine web and rings
r = web.union(ring1).union(ring2)

# Cut the through holes of both rings
hole1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=-0.001)
    .center(0.13, 0.15255)
    .circle(0.1075)
    .extrude(0.02)
)
hole2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=-0.001)
    .center(0.59745, 0.15255)
    .circle(0.13)
    .extrude(0.02)
)

r = r.cut(hole1).cut(hole2)
